wins.label: Investment Banking momentum
wins.evidence: IB fees were up 50% year-on-year and 17% quarter-on-quarter

wins.label: Strong Markets revenue growth
wins.evidence: Markets revenue was up 10% year-on-year, Equity Markets up 21% with record revenue in prime

wins.label: Robust consumer franchise growth
wins.evidence: record number of first-time investors and strong customer acquisition across checking accounts and Card, continued strong net inflows across AWM

wins.label: Capital position strengthened
wins.evidence: CET1 ratio of 15.3%, up 30 basis points versus prior quarter, Board intends to increase quarterly dividend from $1.15 to $1.25

wins.label: Card business performing well
wins.evidence: Card outstandings up 12% due to strong account acquisition, Card NII up on higher revolving balances

risks.label: Net interest income normalization pressure
risks.evidence: deposit margin compression, expected higher deposit costs, migration of noninterest-bearing into interest-bearing deposits will continue

risks.label: Investment Banking pull-forward risk
risks.evidence: pull-forward refinancing activity was meaningful contributor to strong first half, second quarter still reflects pull-forward, reasonably cautious about second half

risks.label: Muted loan demand outside Card
risks.evidence: loan demand remains quite muted everywhere except Card, middle market and large corporate clients remain somewhat cautious, revolver utilization continues below pre-pandemic levels

risks.label: Credit normalization in Card
risks.evidence: net charge-offs up $820 million year-on-year predominantly driven by Card, newer vintages seasoning and credit normalization continues

risks.label: Regulatory capital uncertainty
risks.evidence: preliminary SCB of 3.3% may be higher, Basel III endgame outcomes uncertain, stress capital buffer volatile and untransparent
